{"code":"import random

def generate(rng):
    # Sparse grids with paired colored points, typically encoding vertical bands
    h = rng.randint(7, 14)
    w = rng.randint(5, 10)
    g = [[0 for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    n = rng.randint(2, min(4, h//2))
    colors = rng.sample(range(1, 10), n)
    used = set()
    for color in colors:
        # choose two distinct rows and columns, avoiding collisions
        for _ in range(100):
            r1, r2 = sorted(rng.sample(range(h), 2))
            c1, c2 = rng.sample(range(w), 2)
            if (r1,c1) not in used and (r2,c2) not in used:
                break
        g[r1][c1] = color; g[r2][c2] = color
        used.update([(r1,c1),(r2,c2)])
    return g"}
